svg.title: workstation-steward: AI tooling drift, and a repin with its undo
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in three scenes. steward ai drift checks the AQE runtime, the hybrids, the guards and every project, and finds three launcher configs still pointing at Node 26.4.0, which is no longer the active Node. steward ai repin shows its rule and a plan of three untracked files. steward ai repin --apply asks, changes them with a backup and a receipt, and prints the rollback command; steward ai drift then finds no pinned launchers.

text.tspan: ruflo: receipt matches supply-chain/hybrids.toml and the active Node
Summary: 1 drift, 0 warning(s) across 12 project(s) (9 onboarded, 3 ignored). Nothing was changed.
plan only; run `steward ai repin --apply` to apply (asks first)
Running Codex/Claude sessions keep their servers until restarted; new sessions use the new paths.
no launcher config, AQE hook shim or AQE runtime script points into a version-specific install
